title: Version 2 native vertex input conversion
scope: Component conversion/fetch, native descriptor readers and actual shared-CU vertex execution; full native host rendering remains separate

contract.versions: Input version 1 retains raw format IDs 0-6; input version 2 accepts IDs 0-24. Input version is independent of shader export ABI.
contract.rounding: RNE FP32 conversion; exact rational UNORM, signed normalization with most-negative clamp, exact half expansion with canonical quiet NaNs. Raw FP32 bits are preserved.
contract.packed: Four components per naturally aligned logical four-byte word; X/Y/Z/W low 10/10/10/2 bits. No per-component address stepping.
contract.stage: Capture one component word before conversion; one additional cycle per consumed component, including legacy raw formats.
contract.ABI: Dedicated format wire words use five low bits. Record offsets, sizes and magic are unchanged; padding remains zero.
contract.publication: Host backing changes require explicit cache publication. Actual local/global shader tests reuse the same allocation through driver invalidate and held completion acknowledgement.

coverage: All 25 format IDs, 18 converted layouts; exact rational arithmetic, signed minima, 32-bit rounding boundaries, fixed point and packed channels.
Indexed/instanced cross-line fetch, all 16 attribute slots, typed defaults, packed logical limits, conversion-cycle cancellation, ordinary faults/drain/reuse and 4 GiB exclusive limits.

Actual two-CU local/global converted vertex positions and cached allocation reuse through acknowledged invalidate; legacy indexed instances, texture faults, held exports, spill and shader/staging faults.
16 lanes/eight warps, 128 threads, 16 enabled attributes and 64 varying components through a 69120-byte controlled oversize spill; native fixed-word readers retain exact snapshots, padding and drain.

previous_run.cause: The new fixture rewrote backing bytes behind a warm L2 line. Corrected tests issue and acknowledge actual driver invalidate, preserving the same allocation and exact output checks.

emission.scope: Default 16-attribute/binding standalone fetcher; no new CU, payload pool, SRAM, FMA or divider lane. Structural evidence only.

limitations: GVI1 discovery has separate native control evidence; complete converted native rendering/MMU/image/host composition remains pending.
General resource/allocation provenance, physical aliases, complete geometry reuse/semantics, Mobile runtime/rates/budgets and H0-H8 remain open.
